lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: 40 times I explained my job to ChatGPT.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: You don't need to. Tell it once, in settings.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Settings has a page about me?
directions: on screen: ChatGPT > Settings > Personalization > Custom instructions {{verify menu path}}

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: Custom instructions. What you do, who it's for, how long.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: And it reads that every chat?

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: Every new chat, before your first message.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: So I write "I'm a millionaire" and...

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: It writes like you're a millionaire. You stay broke.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Side hustle 48: explain my job once. Comment SETUP.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: And I'll send the template. So you never explain your job again.
